1. In Telegram, open @BotFather and send /newbot. Pick a name (e.g. "Diya Monitor") and a username ending in "bot".
2. BotFather replies with a token like 123456789:AA… — paste it below.
3. Open your new bot in Telegram and send it any message (e.g. "hi"). To alert a family group instead, add the bot to the group and send a message there.
4. Press "Find chat ID" — the app reads the latest message your bot received and fills in the chat ID. (Or get it from @userinfobot.)
5. Press "Send test message" and check Telegram.

Android\'s battery optimisation can pause apps overnight, which would silently stop monitoring. Allow Diya Monitor to ignore battery optimisation so the camera and alerts keep running for 8–9 hours. Keep the phone plugged in.
⚠️ This is a convenience monitor, not a fire-safety device. Keep a smoke alarm nearby and place the diya on a metal tray away from curtains and anything flammable.
